paper.title_en: Suppression of mass inflation by vanishing inner-horizon surface gravity
paper.abstract_en: Mass inflation is conventionally understood as an instability of black-hole interiors driven by the exponential amplification of counter-streaming perturbations near a non-degenerate inner horizon. In this work, we investigate how this picture is modified when the inner-horizon surface gravity vanishes. Focusing on static, spherically symmetric black-hole geometries with degenerate inner horizons, we formulate the interior problem in a double-null framework and analyze the near-horizon asymptotics for weak ingoing and outgoing null perturbations in the case $\kappa_\textrm{in} = 0$. We show that inner-horizon degeneracy replaces the standard exponential horizon scaling by an algebraic one and, correspondingly, removes the conventional exponential amplification factor from the transport equations of the Misner-Sharp mass. Within the weak asymptotic regime considered here, the effective mass exhibits at most algebraic or logarithmic growth, depending on the decay rates of the perturbing tails, rather than the usual exponentially amplified behavior of the non-degenerate Cauchy-horizon case. We further examine the associated invariant curvature sector and show that, although the unperturbed degenerate inner horizon is curvature-regular, the perturbed interior may still admit a weaker residual singular response. Our results therefore indicate that vanishing inner-horizon surface gravity suppresses the conventional exponential mass-inflation mechanism without, by itself, implying full regularization of the spacetime interior.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文深入研究了引力理论中黑洞内部的质量膨胀机制，提出了在内视界表面引力为零时指数放大被代数增长所取代的新见解，理论深度高，方法严谨，具有创新性。
decision.title_zh: 内视界表面引力为零对质量膨胀的抑制
decision.abstract_zh: 质量膨胀通常被理解为黑洞内部的一种不稳定性，由近非简并内视界的反向传播扰动的指数放大所驱动。在这项工作中，我们研究了当内视界表面引力为零时，这一图景如何被修改。聚焦于具有简并内视界的静态、球对称黑洞几何，我们在双零框架中表述内部问题，并在 $\kappa_\textrm{in} = 0$ 的情况下分析弱入射和出射零扰动的近视界渐近行为。我们表明，内视界简并性将标准的指数视界标度替换为代数标度，并相应地消除了 Misner-Sharp 质量输运方程中传统的指数放大因子。在我们考虑弱渐近区域内，有效质量最多表现出代数或对数增长，这取决于扰动尾部的衰减速率，而非非简并柯西视界情形中通常的指数放大行为。我们进一步检查了相关的不变曲率扇区，并表明，尽管未扰动的简并内视界是曲率正则的，扰动内部仍可能允许较弱的残余奇异响应。因此，我们的结果表明，内视界表面引力为零抑制了传统的指数质量膨胀机制，但就其本身而言，并不意味着时空内部的完全正则化。
